t: You're looking at the statue of Thomas Coram in Brunswick Square Gardens, in Bloomsbury. It's by the sculptor William McMillan and is Grade II listed. Captain Thomas Coram was an English sea captain and philanthropist who created the Foundling Hospital in nearby Lamb's Conduit Fields, to look after abandoned children on the streets of London. It is said to be the world's first incorporated charity. McMillan, a Scottish sculptor, made a number of public statues around the United Kingdom, and this is one of them.
